title: Ghost kitchen internal accounting web app (frontend: auth-gated UI, CRUD screens, calculations, dashboard, and print-ready reports)

requirements.summary: Gate all accounting UI behind Internet Identity login and prepare UI structure for future roles/permissions (profile setup, access denied, centralized auth guard).
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users cannot access any accounting data screens
Authenticated users can log in/out via Internet Identity
Backend endpoints that read/write accounting data reject unauthenticated callers
Authorization logic is centralized so adding roles later does not require rewriting every endpoint

file_operations.description: Wire the app to use the new authenticated App shell/router entry (e.g., import the new app root). Ensure the QueryClient cache is cleared on logout flows. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create the top-level application component that renders an auth-gated shell (navigation + routes) and blocks all accounting views until authenticated. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a centralized route guard that uses Internet Identity state and backend role/profile queries to decide between: login screen, profile setup, access denied, or the main app. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a Login/Logout button built on useInternetIdentity; on logout, clear cached app data (react-query clear) and any derived UI state. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement first-login profile setup UI (ask for name only when getCallerUserProfile() returns null) and persist via saveCallerUserProfile(). Prevent modal flash by respecting actor loading + query fetched state per guidance. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a simple access denied screen to display when authenticated but unauthorized (future roles/permissions ready), and to handle authorization trap errors gracefully. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a react-query hook for getCallerUserProfile() that properly reflects actor dependency (avoid profile setup modal flash). Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a react-query hook for getCallerUserRole() and surface role state for future role-based UI. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

Centralize frontend handling for backend authorization failures (e.g., traps) into user-friendly English messages and consistent redirect/deny behavior. Verify the authorization component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build desktop-optimized data entry and review UI for Expenses, Sales/Revenue, and COGS with validation, dropdowns, and editable tables.
acceptanceCriteria: Expenses form includes: Date, Category dropdown, Vendor dropdown, Description, Amount, Payment Method dropdown
Sales/Revenue form includes: Date, Gross sales, per-platform percentage inputs (e.g., DoorDash, Uber Eats), and Net profit for the day (entered or computed based on the preserved Excel logic)
COGS form includes: Date, Item, Quantity, Cost, Vendor dropdown
Each section provides a list/table view with edit/delete actions
Basic validation prevents invalid numbers and missing required fields
All user-facing text is in English

file_operations.description: Create Expenses entry/edit UI with a form (date/category/vendor/description/amount/payment method), validation, and a table list with edit/delete actions. Compose shadcn-ui components (inputs/select/table/dialog) for consistent UI; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Create Sales/Revenue entry/edit UI with a form (date, gross sales, per-platform percentages, net profit entered or computed via preserved Excel logic) and a table list with edit/delete actions. Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Create COGS entry/edit UI with a form (date, item, quantity, cost, vendor) and a table list with edit/delete actions. Use a frontend data/service abstraction so the UI is ready when backend COGS capabilities are available. Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add react-query hooks for listing/creating/updating/deleting expenses and cache invalidation patterns so tables update after changes. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add react-query hooks for listing/creating/updating/deleting revenue entries and cache invalidation patterns so tables update after changes. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add hooks and a service interface for COGS CRUD that can be wired to backend capabilities when present; ensure the UI can still render and validate fields. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Centralize basic numeric/date required-field validation helpers for the accounting forms to keep UI logic clean and consistent (English messages). Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Register routes/navigation entries for Expenses, Revenue, and COGS pages so they are reachable from the authenticated shell. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add master-data management screens for Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods and ensure all entry forms consume these dynamic dropdown values.
acceptanceCriteria: Dedicated UI pages exist to manage Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods
Changes to master data are immediately reflected in data entry forms without redeploying
Backend prevents deleting master data that is in use (or provides a safe handling strategy such as soft-delete/archiving)

file_operations.description: Create a Master Data management page with sections/tabs for Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods including create/update/delete actions and immediate list refresh. Compose shadcn-ui components (tabs/table/dialog/forms); do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add react-query hooks for fetching and mutating Categories, Vendors, and Payment Methods with consistent cache keys and invalidation so changes propagate immediately into all dropdowns. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Refactor Expenses form dropdowns to source Categories/Vendors/Payment Methods via the shared master-data hooks so updates reflect immediately. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Refactor Revenue form to source Categories via shared master-data hooks (aligned to spreadsheet columns as applicable). Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Refactor COGS form vendor dropdown to source Vendors via shared master-data hooks. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Add navigation/route entry for Master Data management within the authenticated app shell. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Excel-matching calculation logic in a clearly defined, testable frontend formulas module and use it to derive totals/summaries for dashboard and reports.
acceptanceCriteria: System computes: category totals, monthly totals, annual summaries, P&L, margins, and platform fee impacts (based on provided platform percentages)
Calculation results are reproducible and consistent for the same input data
A documented place exists in the codebase to define/adjust the formula logic (so it can be aligned to the spreadsheet), without changing unrelated UI/CRUD flows
Automated tests (backend and/or frontend) validate calculations against at least one set of sample inputs/expected outputs derived from the Excel spreadsheets once provided

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated formulas module that encodes the Excel-equivalent calculations (totals, P&L, margins, platform fees) as pure functions with explicit inputs/outputs, so logic can be adjusted without touching UI/CRUD flows. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add a sample input/expected-output fixture placeholder structure for validating formulas against Excel-derived values once provided (keep English keys/notes). Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Add automated unit tests for the formulas module using the fixture(s) to validate 1:1 calculation outputs. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Update dashboard computations to use the centralized formulas module (no duplicated math in UI). Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Update report computations to use the centralized formulas module to ensure consistency with Excel logic across all report types. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Create a KPI dashboard with selectable time windows and configurable color-coded profitability/margin indicators, backed by live data reloads.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays Total profit, Total expenses, Profit margin, and COGS for the selected time window
User can switch between current day, current month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months
Values are color-coded: green for profitable/positive, red for loss/negative or margin below threshold (threshold is configurable)
Dashboard loads data from backend APIs and updates when new entries are added

file_operations.description: Implement the main Dashboard view with KPI cards (profit, expenses, margin, COGS), time-window selector, and color-coded semantics based on configurable thresholds; compute values via the centralized formulas module and data hooks. Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add a reusable KPI card component that supports numeric alignment, green/red semantics, and compact desktop layout. Compose shadcn-ui components where helpful; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add a time window selector (day/month/3/6/12 months) used by the dashboard (and optionally reports) for consistent filtering UX. Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Define configurable dashboard thresholds (e.g., margin threshold) and any shared constants for time-window definitions in one place. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Create a hook that gathers required data (expenses, revenue, COGS when available) and derives dashboard KPIs for the selected time window, ensuring updates after mutations via react-query invalidation. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Add/ensure a primary navigation link and route registration for the Dashboard as the authenticated landing screen. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Build print-friendly report views for daily/monthly/annual and rolling-window summaries with spreadsheet-style tables and dedicated print CSS.
acceptanceCriteria: Each requested report type is accessible from a Reports section with date/month/year selectors as appropriate
Reports render in a clean, table-based accounting layout suitable for printing
Print CSS ensures readable typography, proper page breaks where reasonable, and hides non-report navigation controls during printing
Users can print to PDF using the browser’s print dialog and get a clean output

file_operations.description: Create a Reports section with selectors and navigation for: daily summary, monthly expense report, monthly P&L, 3/6/12-month reports, and annual summary. Render each report in a spreadsheet-style table layout and provide a clear print action (browser print). Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add a shared report layout wrapper that standardizes headings, date ranges, table formatting, and print-only elements across all report types. Compose shadcn-ui components where helpful; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Implement the daily summary report view component using the centralized formulas module and a print-friendly table layout. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Implement the monthly expense report view component with category/vendor breakdowns as dictated by the spreadsheet layout logic, using the centralized formulas module. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Implement the monthly profit & loss report component using centralized formulas for profit/margin/platform fee impacts and a table-based layout suitable for audit/printing. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Implement a reusable rolling-window (3/6/12 months) report component to avoid duplicating layout logic across window sizes. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Implement the annual summary report component using centralized formulas and a print-friendly accounting table layout. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add/ensure global print styles and report-specific print rules: hide app chrome/navigation during printing, preserve readable typography, numeric alignment, and reasonable page breaks for tables. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Register the Reports route and navigation entry so all report types are reachable from the authenticated shell. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply a consistent, professional desktop accounting theme (neutral slate/gray, readable tables, green/red semantics) and ensure print views remove app chrome while retaining structure.
acceptanceCriteria: All primary screens (Dashboard, Expenses, Sales/Revenue, COGS, Master Data, Reports) share a consistent layout, spacing, and typography
Neutral gray/slate palette is used across the UI with green/red reserved for performance semantics
Tables align numbers consistently (e.g., right-aligned amounts) and use clear headings
Print views retain the same visual structure while removing app chrome

file_operations.description: Create a shared desktop-optimized app shell (header/sidebar, content container, consistent spacing/typography) used by all authenticated screens; ensure elements can be hidden in print via CSS hooks/classes. Compose shadcn-ui components; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
Wrap all primary routes/pages in the shared AppShell to enforce consistent layout and navigation placement across screens. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Define/standardize the neutral slate/gray base styling, typography defaults, numeric table alignment helpers, and consistent green/red semantics classes/tokens; ensure print retains structure while removing app chrome. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small reusable presentation component/helper for right-aligned numeric values (currency/percent) to keep tables consistent across screens and reports. Compose shadcn-ui components if needed; do not modify immutable ui components. Verify the shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.
